name: multi-repo
description: Git awareness across every repo in a folder of repos: per-repo status and worktrees in Claude's context, guidance for working across repos in parallel, a band above the prompt, a /repos pane that tidies worktrees, /repos-fetch and a repo_status tool

scanDepth.title: Scan depth
scanDepth.description: How many folder levels below the session root to look for git repos

ignore.title: Extra folders to skip
ignore.description: Comma-separated folder names never searched for repos, added to the built-in list (node_modules, vendor, ...)

showBand.title: Show repo band
showBand.description: Show the repos with changes above the prompt
